name: they-can-count
why: Opens on "Humanity downloaded TikTok over four billion times to watch strangers twerk"; the Politician ignores protests, polls and the rising sea up to his lip, then counts 280 million on his toes, ending on "Because they can count."

name: math-just-sits-there
why: "Your species accuses people of cheating at everything": a Thanksgiving board game ends in a mushroom cloud and skeletons, who lead the mob that shouts itself to death at a chalkboard, ending on "the only trustworthy participant in your democratic process."

name: button-from-the-toilet
why: The 3.5% rule, the Capitol rubbing it off the school blackboard, then segregation, the British Empire and 72 years of suffrage paid in gas, prison and skeletons, against YOU clicking YES from the toilet.
